title: Spain train crash kills at least 68 as witnesses describe devastating scenes - CNN
description: Scores of people have been killed and around 100 injured after two Spanish trains — carrying about 500 passengers — collided south of Madrid. Follow for live updates.

title: Apple Unveils Touch-Screen MacBook Pro, Reversing Longheld Jobs Stance - Bloomberg.com
description: After two decades of spurning the idea, Apple Inc. unveiled an overhauled MacBook Pro that includes a touch screen, giving its flagship laptop a feature that has become a must-have in the personal computer industry.

title: Iran pressed to make nuke concessions as massive post-midterms strikes loom - Axios
description: Mediators are working to reach a diplomatic off-ramp.

title: Google adding more Connected Apps to Gemini & Search with new dev platform - 9to5Google
description: Google announced the Connected Apps Platform as a “unified way for more app developers to bring their capabilities directly into Gemini and Search.”

title: Weil Practice Head Tells Lawyers to Find Jobs as Firm Struggles - Bloomberg Law News
description: The leader of a Weil Gotshal & Manges practice group told his junior lawyers to look for employment, underscoring the firm’s perilous state as it consults with a restructuring lawyer.
